# `fact` content schema

<!-- Generated by pnpm content:docs from the "fact" schema in src/content/registry.ts; do not edit. -->

One JSON file per entry in `src/content/data/fact/`. Fields marked "required" must be present;
every other field takes the default shown when omitted ("—" = stays absent).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | id | required | Group id, e.g. "endings". Facts are keyed by `key`, not by this. |
| `name` | string | required | Display name (docs and debug tools). |
| `notes` | string | required | What these facts cover and where they come from (canon section), for review. |
| `facts` | list of object (at least 1) | required | The facts this group declares. |
| `facts[].key` | string | required | Fact key, or an `entity:*.<fact>` template for a fact every entity can hold. |
| `facts[].description` | string | required | What the fact records, when it changes and what reads it (designers, owner review). |
| `facts[].owner` | id | required | System that writes the fact, e.g. "signals", "quest", "interaction". |
| `facts[].persistence` | `"permanent"` | `"permanent"` | How long a written value lasts; `permanent` keeps it in saves forever. |
| `facts[].type` | `"bool"` | required | A true/false flag. |
| `facts[].default` | boolean | required | Value read before the fact is first written. |
| `facts[].type` | `"int"` | required | A whole number (a count, a stage). |
| `facts[].default` | integer | required | Value read before the fact is first written. |
| `facts[].type` | `"enum"` | required | One of a fixed list of `values`. |
| `facts[].values` | list of id (at least 1) | required | The allowed values, unique. |
| `facts[].default` | id | required | Value read before the fact is first written; one of `values`. |
| `facts[].type` | `"id"` | required | A content id (who rang the bell, which item). |
| `facts[].default` | id or null | required | Content id read before the first write, or null. |
| `facts[].type` | `"tick"` | required | A sim tick (when something happened), never wall time. |
| `facts[].default` | integer ≥ 0 or null | required | Sim tick read before the first write, or null. |
